## Description and Rationale

SevinHub is an independent technology initiative based in Belgium, led by Sergiu Nicolae. I build data-driven software and experimental tools that turn complex real-world datasets into useful, understandable systems. I joined the PRC Data Challenge to explore rigorous and reproducible methods for predicting taxi-out time, learn more about European airport operations, and contribute an openly documented solution to the aviation research community. The connection between operational efficiency, fuel consumption and CO₂ emissions makes this challenge particularly meaningful to me.
